text: The determinant of an upper triangular matrix equals:
choices: the sum of its diagonal entries
the product of its diagonal entries
the product of its nonzero entries
explanation: In the Leibniz expansion only the identity permutation avoids the zeros below the diagonal, leaving ∏ᵢ Aᵢᵢ. This underlies the efficient algorithm: row-reduce to triangular form, tracking swaps and scalings, then multiply the diagonal.
